next_action.description: Fill the empty `Masking` group in comfy_workflows/raw/flow_character_sheet.json. Read plan.md `## Current State` TOP BLOCK first - it carries the whole boundary contract, read off the file, so do not re-derive it. IN: `736 GetNode` name 'sheet output' (IMAGE, currently UNLINKED - it is yours), plus `743 Get_W` and `744 Get_H` (INT). OUT: `733 SetNode` name 'inpaint mask', a PLAIN MASK, also unlinked. Group bbox is [-463.6, 4787.1, 2960.0, 1411.1]; free canvas is roughly x -200..2200, y 4790..6190. Build: face_yolov8n via UltralyticsDetectorProvider + BboxDetectorSEGS -> ImpactSEGSOrderedFilter ordered by AREA ascending, take_start 0 take_count 1 (NEVER by detection index - SAM3 sorts by confidence, so 'face two' is a race a third weak hit reorders) to pick the FRONT body's head; then SAM3_Detect on hair + face + hat, unioned, as the mask that actually gets filled, degrading to hair+face when the character has no hat. Do NOT bake a grow: 735 Get_inpaint mask already feeds 690 GrowMaskWithBlur, and 734 feeds 721 MpiMaskSquareBbox + 718 InpaintCropImproved. Prefix every new Set/Get name (mask_*) - names are matched by NAME and a collision cross-wires SILENTLY while link integrity still passes. Read docs/masking-sam3.md BEFORE authoring the SAM3 half: positive_coords/negative_coords are forceInput STRING wired from MpiText (never MpiString, which is media-staged), and the text branch feeds SAM3 through CLIPTextEncode off the SAM3 checkpoint's own CLIP. Verify offline the way the earlier patches were verified - link integrity, Set/Get orphan check, reachability from the outputs, unique Input_/Output_ titles - then node scripts/workflow-to-api.mjs against live /object_info.

key_decisions: ONE GRAPH, ONE OP, gated by a boolean - not two graphs chained. Flows dispatch a single operation, so a separate inpaint workflow would mean two queue jobs and two gallery cards for one sheet.

FABIO OWNS THE MERGE, THE AGENT OWNS THE GROUP. He merged t2i + inpaint himself and left a walled garden, which removes the one failure mode a scripted merge has here: SetNode/GetNode pairs match by NAME, so a collision cross-wires silently and link integrity still passes.
The enhanced phrase is injected into `Input_Positive`, NOT `Input_Character`. That name only ever existed in the scratch fixture and is wrong against this graph.

`--accent-frost` IS A COLOUR TO MOVE AWAY FROM (Fabio, 2026-08-20): used in ~3% of the app and 'should be a colour that shouldn't be used anywhere'. Do not reach for it as a signal colour. Every declared field's :focus-visible ring is still frost - noted, app-wide, its own job.
Storing a seed stays rejected. The enhanced TEXT is stored and injected verbatim; the enhancer seed is load-bearing INSIDE the run and the frame drives a fresh one per press.
constraints: comfy_workflows/raw/ IS USER-OWNED. The Masking group is the one place in that file the agent may author. Anything else - moving the Input_Remove_Head gate, adding Input_Seed to the enhancer - is Fabio's edit to make; ask, do not do.

THE CHARACTER-SHEET FlowDef IS NOT IN THE REPO, deliberately - no op, no graph yet. The scratch fixture is recorded VERBATIM in validation.md; paste it into js/data/flowsRegistry.js to drive the UI and DELETE IT before committing. Driving it: Events.emit('flow:open', {flowId:'character-sheet'}) from a playwright-cli eval, and A PROJECT MUST BE OPEN FIRST - on Landing the overlay mounts but is not visible, which reads as a broken flow and is not one.

A PEER SESSION IS LIVE IN THIS TREE and edits the same files. 25a96d14 swept Fabio's in-flight conversion of the remaining declared-field types onto Primitives (MpiInput/MpiProgressBar in declaredFields.js) along with the button work - healthy at lint + 630/630 when committed, but he may want to amend or split it. Assume any co-owned file may be committed out from under you.

NEVER take the user's app on :3000. Spin your own with `npm run app:isolated` - it prints `READY <url>`. DO NOT pipe it through head/tail: the buffer swallows the READY line, a working launch reads as a hang, and the orphan then holds the profile so the NEXT launch dies at exit 0. Stopping it needs the process TREE, and `taskkill /PID` from the Bash tool is mangled by Git Bash into 'C:/Program Files/Git/PID' - drive it through powershell instead.

A FIRST RUN of app:isolated leaves an orphan .mpi-modal-backdrop after the 18+ gate: the changelog dialog mounts behind it and the backdrop eats every click, so the landing page reads as frozen. Remove the node and carry on. Not a card, but it will cost ten minutes if unexpected.

A SCREENSHOT IS PART OF VERIFYING THIS UI, not a nicety - every DOM assertion passed once while the step was visibly broken. And computed colours serialise as oklch(), so a regex 'rgb' parse returns a plausible wrong number; go through a 1x1 canvas instead.

THE GPU NEEDS THE LEASE for anything that executes a generation: python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/mpi-lib/scripts/gpu_lease.py" run -- <command>. Machine-global, one slot. Read-only probes are not matched.
